verdict.rationale: Mollie is a payments API and SaaS platform, not an AI agent or host application. Plugging in third-party MCP servers so the product can use their tools is an MCP-client role, which is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only that Mollie publishes its own MCP server for use by clients like Claude Desktop and Cursor; that is the separate server-side story and does not make the client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
